analysis.executive_summary: Audit of docs.cortex.io covered 314 pages with 100% crawl coverage and 91.5% overall confidence. Documentation contains 3 confirmed broken internal links requiring immediate repair. API reference coverage stands at 25.46% across 96 detected API pages, indicating significant gaps in usage documentation. SEO/metadata issues affect 36.46% of pages, impacting discoverability. Example code reliability could not be verified (0.0% estimate), presenting unknown quality risk.
strengths: Complete crawl coverage achieved (100%) with 314 pages successfully indexed
High overall audit confidence at 91.5% with strong link verification (95% confidence)
No repository navigation link breakage detected (repo_broken_links_count: 0)
Full last-updated metadata coverage (100%) enables freshness tracking
Single-product topology provides clear documentation structure
risks: 3 confirmed broken internal documentation links degrade user navigation experience
API reference coverage at 25.46% leaves 74.54% of API pages without adequate usage documentation
SEO/metadata issues on 36.46% of pages (115 pages) severely limit search discoverability
Example code reliability at 0.0% indicates no executable examples verified or potential detection failure
96 API pages detected but only 25% have corresponding usage guidance creates integration friction
32 trap URLs skipped during crawl may hide additional content quality issues
56 excluded links not verified could contain additional broken references

prioritized_actions.action: Repair 3 confirmed broken internal documentation links to restore navigation integrity
Expand API usage documentation to cover remaining 71 API pages (targeting 80%+ coverage)
Remediate SEO/metadata issues on 115 pages (36.46%) to improve search visibility and organic traffic
Investigate example code detection failure and establish executable example validation pipeline
Review 32 trap URLs and 56 excluded links to identify false positives and hidden content issues

limitations: External audit cannot verify actual functionality or accuracy of code examples, API endpoints, or technical instructions
0.0% example reliability may indicate detection methodology limitations rather than absence of examples
Crawl excludes authentication-required pages, private documentation, and dynamically generated content not discoverable via links
Link verification confirms HTTP response codes but cannot validate semantic correctness or content relevance of destinations
SEO issue detection based on metadata presence/format only; cannot measure actual search engine ranking or user engagement impact
